game_name: Orwell: Keeping an Eye On You
review_text_raw:
MW2 menu music
Take your time
This plot escalates quickly at times
There will be consequences for bad time managment
Would of loved this game to have voice actors
Seems to be rather replayable
Many charactors with complex online personas

Only issues I have with the game is that I opted to play on my laptop without a mouse so I was force to drag down scroll icons a lot... yes I tried the arrows maybe there is another shortcut but yeah. Aslo I had to exit once because all the menus locked out. Oh and don't expect to load episodes from what I have seen, you will likely need to start over completely.

Got the game free from Humble Bundle finally around to playing the game now I kinda think I hsould of kept the code for the second one.
